name: v0.3.49 — Raised camera button in the bottom bar
releaseNotes:
• New raised camera button in the centre of the bottom bar — one tap to add a receipt (photo / gallery / voice) from any screen.
• Bottom bar is now Home · Receipts · 📷 · Smashlist · Menu (Miles moved to the quick-launch strip).
• Quick-launch strip + restored dashboard feature pills from v0.3.48 included.
